title: Q3 完成即付：预算约束下重新优化奖励
summary: Two ledgers separated (q = incremental reroutes, P = payable head count, payment = r*P). The bill r*sum(pi(r)x) is put inside the stacked 24-hour LP and B in {30k,60k,100k,170k,none} is swept over a 0.01-CNY r grid. Main scheme keeps the surplus source cap and adds T019 fence-capacity rows. At B=170k the arrivals caliber gives r*=1.72, q=92,119.6, P=97,882.3, payment=168,357.6 (within budget); the surplus caliber at B=60k gives r*=1.78, q=31,507.5, P=33,353.5, payment=59,369.3. Without budget the surplus optimum is r*=1.82, q=32,389.5, P=34,210.3, payment=62,262.7, total 674,925.7 (6.33% cell-level equivalent). Feeding the incentive's zone-hour OD change into the T018 integer scheduler gives a pure-truck objective of 83,807.74 against hybrid totals of 143,782-256,876, i.e. a system saving of -71.6% to -206.5%: under the Q2 service constraints the incentive program is a net cost, and the old 6.83%-20.83% is only a cell-level equivalent benchmark.

notes: The hard-budget reservation rule is far more conservative than an expected-payment budget: reserving r per invitation puts the full-day reserve at 238,418-358,699 CNY, so B=30k-170k stop issuing at hour 7-8 and the realised q is 3,634-43,760, i.e. 4-47% of the LP plan. Overrun probability is 0 by construction in all 1,000-day simulations; the cost of that guarantee is the truncation. An operator who budgets on expected payment instead (the LP rows) can spend the full B but accepts a non-zero overrun tail that this delivery does not quantify.

The fence-capacity constraint covers only cells inside an open T019 site. Reroutes to the 1,009 cells served by no fence are 21.1-22.7% of q and are reported separately (policy_table.json q_outside_sites); they are physically uncapacitated by the fence system, not verified empty.

Feeding the incentive into T018 requires re-fitting PZ, because T018 generates arrivals from PZ and its raw ARR matrix is unused. The IPF keeps departure rows fixed and moves column totals to the incentive's zone-hour arrival totals (row error 3.6e-12, column error 2.1e-4 relative ~2e-9). This is an aggregate translation: only 6.9% of reroutes (|delta| 4,471 / 2q = 64,780) cross a zone boundary, consistent with the paper's 7.46% figure.

The negative system saving is robust to the IPF method: the largest conceivable truck-side benefit is 3.3305 x the positive zone-hour arrival change = 14,003 CNY (arrivals) / 7,446 CNY (surplus), against payments of 172,327 / 62,263. Even a perfect truck response would leave the hybrid far more expensive than pure truck.
Both sides of the hybrid comparison carry the T018 fixed cost of 36,000 CNY (600 x K=60), so the difference is variable truck cost plus payment; no fixed cost is double-counted or dropped.
No parameter of the logit model (kappa=2.0, rho=0.35, c0=0.8) was changed; T008's seven parameter sets remain the sensitivity basis and were not re-run here.
All totals use N=216,343.75 and c_truck=3.3305185482504633 CNY, the same constants as T008.
paper/ was not modified; the affected entries are proposals for T021.
